reddit.title: Improved Music Experience in Provincia
reddit.body: We've made some exciting updates to the music in Provincia! No more jarring transitions between day, night, title, and combat beds. Our new long equal-power self-crossfade technique ensures a seamless audio experience. Learn more about these improvements and how they enhance your gameplay here: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/soft-music-reloops?utm_source=reddit&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=soft-music-reloops

steam.title: Audio Enhancements in Provincia
steam.body: We're thrilled to announce that we've improved the audio experience in Provincia! With our new long equal-power self-crossfade technique, transitions between day, night, title, and combat beds are now seamless. This update enhances immersion and gameplay. Learn more about these changes in our latest dev talk: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/soft-music-reloops?utm_source=steam&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=soft-music-reloops
